text: He said his garden would never die... by the next morning, it was gone.
Allah tells of a man who was given two gardens of grapevines, bordered with palm trees, with crops between them.
One day he walked into his garden with his friend, proud of all he had, and said:
His friend said: Why, when you entered your garden, did you not say: Masha'Allah, la quwwata illa billah?
That night, his fruit was destroyed, and his vines collapsed onto their trellises.
So whenever you see a blessing, say: Masha'Allah, la quwwata illa billah.
